summary: Removed the spec-declared lowercase ticker_patterns regex from newLearnConfig.
reason: The spec declared ticker_patterns: ^[a-z0-9]{2,12}$, which is inverted for this API. entities.Extract applies matchesTicker to the RAW token before lowercasing and at higher precedence than its ALL-CAPS rule, so the pattern could never match a real PSX symbol (HUBC, OGDC are already entities via that rule) and instead matched every ordinary lowercase word. QueryFamily -- a bag of NON-entity tokens -- therefore returned empty for every example, every seeded playbook was skipped as unreachable at recall time, and 20 generated tests failed. The spec was corrected too.
validated_outcome: go test ./... 20 failures -> 0; recall surface restored; scorecard unchanged.
